sources: https://www.lumenpulse.com/company/news/41/winnipegs-emptyful-sculpture-all-lit-up-by-lumenpulse (17 Sep 2012; colour-changing lights; fog and water off in winter)
sculptures.note: Flask outline (round-bottomed body, straight shoulders, neck capped by a flat ring) as a deep metal band, tilted; a level bar across the body is the liquid's surface — lights on its top shine up on the metal, fog rises from it and a water curtain hangs below it in summer. Summer cool colours, winter warm; lights at night. From Mike's photo, 2026-10-22.
